summary.business_type: B2B clinical planning service (VSP, maxillofacial surgery), single-page static site
top_findings: Backup versions of the site are live and indexable
One page cannot target service keywords; H1/title lack query terms
Weak trust/E-E-A-T and missing privacy/terms for a YMYL medical offering

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with http and www 301 redirects
Valid lang, viewport, landmarks, single H1

findings.title: No robots.txt or sitemap.xml
findings.recommendation: Add both at repo root and reference the sitemap in robots.txt.

findings.title: Backup pages published
findings.description: /backup/round-3/ and /backup/coming-soon-v0/ return 200 with their own titles and no canonical/noindex.
findings.recommendation: Remove from the published branch or noindex and disallow.

findings.title: Unused heavy media published
findings.description: maxmorph-motion.mp4 (2 MB) and duplicate logo PNGs are crawlable but unreferenced.
findings.recommendation: Delete or move out of the Pages root.

findings.title: Thin, single-page content (~550 words)
findings.description: No process, pricing model, cases, validation data or FAQ.
findings.recommendation: Create dedicated service/process/about pages with evidence.

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T and trust signals for YMYL
findings.description: No credentials, regulatory status, privacy policy or terms; testimonial/client sections hidden.
findings.recommendation: Add credentials, regulatory position, data-handling statement and real case evidence.

findings.title: Title and H1 lack target terms
findings.description: 'Virtual surgical planning' appears only in the meta description.
findings.recommendation: Rework title and spell out Virtual Surgical Planning (VSP) near the top.

findings.title: Incomplete social meta and icons
findings.description: Missing og:url/type/site_name, image dimensions, twitter tags; OG image is 1600x1600 PNG 830 KB; favicon 125px only.
findings.recommendation: Add tags, 1200x630 OG image, apple-touch-icon and icon set.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.recommendation: Add Organization, Person and WebSite JSON-LD with sameAs.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop LCP 1.36 s, mobile LCP 0.42 s

findings.title: Mobile CLS 0.108
findings.recommendation: Reserve space for hero/logo and font swap; re-measure.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts and ~1 MB images on desktop
findings.description: Third-party font CSS; four WebPs of 195-320 KB.

findings.title: Mobile navigation missing
findings.description: Nav is hidden under 900px with no menu button.

findings.title: No llms.txt, no explicit AI crawler policy, low passage citability
findings.recommendation: Add robots.txt policy and answer-style passages; llms.txt optional.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP with dimensions and lazy loading

findings.title: OG image oversized/square; unused PNGs published
findings.recommendation: Use 1200x630 under 150 KB; remove unused originals.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Rewrite title and spell out VSP

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Drift baseline and compare per deploy
